subject: Quiet succession map and performance handoff
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quiet succession map and performance handoff

Team —

Following our skip-level and the product roadmap re-prioritization, I think we should consolidate the inference infra and runtime teams into a single execution org under Marcus for the next 6 months. The goals: reduce duplicated ownership, speed up cross-cutting kernel fixes, and make on-call rotations simpler while we transition some senior IC scope.

What I'm proposing (high level):
- Combine Runtime & Serving infra pod leads into one engineering group led by Marcus.
- Identify 2 potential successors for each current senior lead (quiet mapping) — nominate one as an interim lead where appropriate.
- Run targeted performance calibrations for affected ICs this sprint; do not publicize beyond direct stakeholders.

Ask: please review the attached draft succession map and role-mapping sheet and reply with concerns by EOD Tue. I want a short, private sync Thurs to land language for 1:1s.

Attachments: succession-draft-v1.docx (doc), role-mapping.xlsx (xlsx)

Nikhil
VP, Product & Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quiet succession map and performance handoff

Nikhil —

Thanks for the draft. High level: I support consolidation but we need to lock down two things before we proceed: calibration and a narrow legal/comp check for any interim promotion or title change. From experience, quiet succession without calibrated ratings leads to surprises during comp cycle.

Specifics: 
- Can we run a rapid calibration rubric for the 6 affected senior ICs? I suggest Marcus/engineers + Lauren join; Monica will need to sign off on wording we use for one-week 1:1s.
- Please flag any promotions that would change comp bands. Those need HR pre-approval.

I'll comment on the role-mapping sheet with notes by tomorrow morning and schedule a quick calibration meeting. Keep this limited to the current thread.

–Marcus
Director of Infrastructure

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quiet succession map and performance handoff

Nikhil / Marcus —

Read the draft; thumbs up on the consolidation but want to call out a few operational guardrails and a proposed timeline:

Proposed timeline (tight):
- Fri Jan 15: Calibration rubric + private one-pager for managers (we will finalize wording).
- Mon Jan 18: 1:1s with affected ICs (one-week window to follow up as needed).
- Wed Jan 20: Finalize interim assignments and update on-call rota.

Talking points for 1:1s (keep short and compassionate):
- Explain business reason for consolidation and what success looks like.
- Share that this is a temporary structure to speed prioritization, not an immediate signal about comp/levels.
- If considering interim assignment/promotion, say "we're discussing scope and readiness; we'll work with HR to confirm titles and comp implications."

Monica — can you confirm the minimum HR review items (titles, comp exceptions, disclosure limits)? If there are legal constraints we should escalate early.

Lauren
Sr. Director, Product Management

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quiet succession map and performance handoff

Thanks for the heads up. A few quick HR guardrails: 

- Any interim title/promotion that would move someone across bands requires compensation review and approval (48–72 hours typical if packet complete).
- We should document who is included in the "quiet succession" list and limit access to direct managers + People Ops lead.
- For any formal role change we need a brief written consent from the person (we can handle the template).

I'll mark the items in role-mapping.xlsx and send a short manager-facing script by EOD Sun. If legal gets involved for employment terms we'll loop counsel as needed — I can coordinate that.

Monica
Head of People Operations (Interim)
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 17:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quiet succession map and performance handoff — agreed plan

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Based on feedback we will: 

1) Proceed with the consolidation under Marcus effective Jan 20 (interim structure for 6 months).
2) Run the calibration rubric on Tue Jan 19 (Marcus + Lauren + 2 peer managers). Monica to own HR sign-off checklist.
3) Conduct discreet 1:1s on Wed Jan 20 — managers will use the talking points Lauren drafted.
4) Any interim title change will be routed through Monica for comp/legal review before being shared.

Monica — please attach the manager-facing script and the HR review template (I will include the final-succession-map.pdf when we sync). Also, please set up a 30-min follow-up with People Ops & Legal for Thurs Jan 21.

I'll book the calibration slot for Tue and set the 1:1 calendar invites. Keep audience tight.

Attachments: final-succession-map.pdf (pdf)

Nikhil
VP, Product & Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference
